title: Higanbana Battlegrounds
pitch: Wake among the red spider lilies on the far shore of the river of the dead, master one of the Five Phases and out-fight every other soul, while every hit you land spills Ki that wakes the Thirsting Elder, a tree that only the right phase can wound.
core_loop: choose a phase fighter at the Ferry Landing (or counter-pick from the death recap)
fight other souls in the dry riverbed, reading Overcome / Resisted / Feeding / Drawing on every target
spend the Ki your hits earn on an ultimate or on a Mend
score kills, streaks and Lily Petals; a death returns you to the landing to re-pick
spilled Ki fills the Thirst; the Thirsting Elder wakes and only the phase that overcomes its heart can wound it; fell it for Petals, Elder's Sap and the Lily Crown
win_condition: No round end (the genre's sandbox free-for-all). A session is won by topping the server Petal board; each awakening of the Thirsting Elder is won when the server fells it inside 4 minutes, and its top damage dealer wears the Lily Crown.
lose_condition: Health reaches 0, or a fall off the shore into the mist: the streak is lost and the soul returns to the Ferry Landing after 4 s. If the Elder is not felled within 4 minutes it drinks its fill, sinks back and pays nobody.
out_of_scope: saving anything between sessions (no DataStore or ProfileStore this build)
shop, Robux, game passes, developer products
more than five fighters, a second map, PvE mobs other than the Elder and its Sap Sprouts
voice lines, cutscenes, custom chat, localization
any name, character, design, power, place or plot from the anime the brief referenced (the banned list lives in tests/originality.spec.luau, which scans src/, design/*.json and default.project.json)

map.note: proven (prove WARN only: T6 coast, T8 cliff cover, P2) and installed in places/HiganbanaBattlegrounds.rbxl

meshes.note: 38 meshes via Studio generate_mesh, manifest assets/meshes/manifest.json

ui.note: runtime-built UI, exported trees in assets/ui/, mockup assets/ui/mockup.png

relations.Overcome: attacker's phase overcomes the target's: +20% damage, +50% guard damage. Red arrow icon.
relations.Resisted: the target's phase overcomes the attacker's: -15% damage. Grey shield icon.
relations.Feeding: the attacker's phase generates the target's: -10% damage and the target gains Ki equal to half of what the attacker would. Green leaf icon.
relations.Drawing: the target's phase generates the attacker's: normal damage, the attacker gains +50% Ki. Crimson mote icon.

phases.note: Every pair of different phases is exactly one of Overcome/Resisted/Feeding/Drawing, so every phase has the same matchup profile: balanced by construction. Covered by a Lune spec in section 2.

roster.title: the Briar Shrine-Keeper
roster.weapon: war wagasa (oil-paper umbrella with a steel ferrule), held; opens into a shield

moves.M1: Umbrella Strikes: 4-hit chain, 6-stud reach, 4 dmg per hit; hit 4 snaps the canopy open for knockback
moves.1: Root Snare: roots burst at an aimed point up to 30 studs away after a 0.5 s tell; 9 dmg and a 1.2 s root in 7 studs. CD 10 s
moves.2: Seed Volley: 5 seed darts in a fan, 3 dmg each; each hit adds a Sprout stack, 3 stacks burst for 8 dmg and a 0.6 s root. CD 8 s
moves.3: Canopy Guard: opens the umbrella for 1.5 s; frontal shield that reflects projectiles back at their owner; melee attackers are rooted 0.8 s. CD 12 s
moves.4: Graft: a vine lash tethers the first enemy within 25 studs and pulls Tsuta to them; her next 3 hits heal her for 40% of damage dealt. CD 14 s
moves.G: Thousand-Root Bloom (ultimate, 100 Ki): plants the umbrella; a giant lily-root tree erupts in 22 studs, roots everyone inside 2 s, 28 dmg over 3 s, heals Tsuta 30% of damage dealt

roster.story: Tended the spider-lily shrine on the far bank for longer than she can remember; she knows which roots drink.

roster.title: the Ember Drummer
roster.weapon: twin taiko bachi (drumsticks), held one per hand
roster.worn: a small war taiko strapped on the back

moves.M1: Bachi Strikes: fast 4-hit chain, 3.5 dmg per hit; hit 4 is a double overhead strike that bursts into flame (knockback, burn)
moves.1: War Beat: strikes the drum on his back; a 12-stud ring shockwave, 10 dmg, knockback and burn. CD 9 s
moves.2: Fire Roll: drums the ground; a line of flame geysers travels 30 studs forward over 0.8 s, 11 dmg. CD 10 s
moves.3: Kakegoe: a battle shout; 3 s of super armor and +20% move speed, and his next hit is a Beat. CD 15 s
moves.4: Thunder Roll: 1.5 s channel, five flame pulses in a forward cone (3 dmg each), the last launches. CD 13 s
moves.G: Festival of a Thousand Drums (ultimate, 100 Ki): phantom taiko ring him in 18 studs and beat in sequence, then all at once: 30 dmg total, the final beat launches and burns

roster.passive: Rhythm: every 3rd consecutive landed hit within 2 s is a Beat: +25% damage and a small flame burst
roster.story: Beat the march for an army that never came home; he still keeps time.

roster.title: the Mountain Rikishi
roster.weapon: none: bare hands in stone bracers
roster.worn: stone bracers on both forearms and a braided white rope belt with paper streamers

moves.M1: Tsuppari: heavy open-palm slaps, 4-hit chain, 5 dmg per hit; hit 4 is a two-handed shove with big knockback
moves.1: Shiko Stomp: the sumo leg-raise stomp; 12-stud ring, 9 dmg, 0.8 s stun, breaks guard. CD 11 s
moves.2: Boulder Grip: a short grab; on catch, lifts and throws the target 25 studs in the aimed direction, 12 dmg on landing, +6 into a wall. CD 12 s
moves.3: Purifying Salt: a cone of thrown salt; strips buffs and stops Ki gain and Mend for 3 s (Purified). CD 14 s
moves.4: Tachiai Charge: a straight charge that carries the first enemy; slamming them into a wall or another player causes a stone shockwave, 13 dmg. CD 12 s
moves.G: Dohyo of the Mountain (ultimate, 100 Ki): raises a 16-stud stone ring around him for 6 s; enemies inside cannot leave; he gains super armor; anyone thrown or knocked out of the ring takes 25 dmg (ring-out)

roster.story: The shrine festival's champion wrestler; the mountain he stood on is somewhere under the lilies.

roster.title: the Iron Constable
roster.weapon: jitte (hooked steel truncheon), held; a weighted chain at the belt

moves.M1: Jitte Strikes: quick 4-hit chain, 3.5 dmg per hit; hit 4 hooks and twists (0.6 s stagger)
moves.1: Chain Lash: throws the weighted chain 25 studs in a line; binds the first enemy (60% slow, 2 s), 8 dmg, and yanks them 8 studs toward him. CD 9 s
moves.2: Jitte Catch: a 0.6 s counter stance; catching a melee hit or a weapon projectile silences the attacker 2.5 s and counter-strikes for 10 dmg. CD 11 s
moves.3: Iron Edict: drives the jitte into the ground; a line of iron spikes erupts 24 studs forward, 11 dmg and +100% guard damage. CD 10 s
moves.4: Hunter's Chase: dashes to the last enemy he hit (within 40 studs and 6 s) with a stunning blow, 9 dmg, 0.7 s stun. CD 13 s
moves.G: Edict of Chains (ultimate, 100 Ki): chains burst from the ground within 20 studs, binding every enemy 2.5 s and dragging them to him; then an iron shockwave, 30 dmg

roster.passive: Arrest: his parries also silence the attacker for 2 s
roster.story: Arrested the wrong man the night the war began; he has been chasing the right one ever since.

roster.title: the Sanzu Ferryman
roster.weapon: a long ferry oar, held two-handed like a staff
roster.worn: a wide straw sugegasa hat and a string of six square-holed coins at the belt

moves.M1: Oar Sweeps: wide sweeps with 9-stud reach, 4.5 dmg per hit; hit 4 scoops upward (launch)
moves.1: Riverpull: a ghost-water sweep that pulls enemies in a 20-stud cone toward him, 7 dmg. CD 10 s
moves.2: Phantom Ferry: rides a phantom boat 35 studs forward, running enemies over: 10 dmg and knockback. CD 12 s
moves.3: Mist of the Crossing: mist in 14 studs for 4 s; enemies inside are slowed 40%; he turns half-transparent. CD 15 s
moves.4: Toll Strike: an overhead oar blow, 8 dmg plus 6 per coin held; spends all coins. CD 9 s
moves.G: The River Returns (ultimate, 100 Ki): the dry river floods a 50-stud lane in the aimed direction: the wave carries enemies with it and slows them, then drains and stuns 1 s; 26 dmg

roster.passive: Fare: every 6th landed hit earns a coin (max 6)
roster.story: The ferryman of the dry river, out of work since it ran dry; whoever crosses back will need a boat.

elder.name: the Thirsting Elder
elder.what: a colossal ancient tree grown over the war's last battlefield: scarred dark-red bark, hollow reed-like branches ending in open tubes, old armour and banners in its roots, red spider lilies at its feet, and a hollow heart that glows in the colour of its current phase. It never walks; it attacks across its grove with roots and branches.
elder.wakes: when the server Thirst (total damage players deal to each other) reaches ThirstBase + ThirstPerPlayer x players, no earlier than 120 s after the server starts and 180 s after its last fall
elder.health: ElderHealthBase + ElderHealthPerPlayer x players at awakening; cannot be stunned or knocked back
elder.heart: cycles along the generating order Wood > Fire > Earth > Metal > Water every 18 s (12 s when enraged), with a 3 s warning
rules: regenerates 1.5% of max health per second
a hit from the phase that overcomes its heart deals +50% and pauses regeneration for 4 s (Wound)
a hit from the phase its heart is generated by (Feeding) heals it for half the damage instead
other hits deal normal damage with the usual relation multipliers
attacks: Root Eruption: red circles under 1-3 players for 1.2 s, then roots burst up: 14 dmg and launch

Thirsting Reach: a red line toward the nearest player for 0.9 s, then a hollow branch grabs them and drains 15 health per second for 2.5 s, healing the Elder; any player can break the branch (120 health) to free them
Petal Storm: raises its branches for 2 s, then a ring of razor petals expands from the trunk: jump over it (16 dmg)
Enrage below 35%: faster heart cycle and attacks, and 3 Sap Sprouts spawn that heal it 5% each unless destroyed within 10 s
elder.timeout: 240 s: it drinks its fill, heals to full, sinks back dormant and pays nobody
elder.rewards: every player who dealt at least 4% of its health: +30 Petals and Elder's Sap (+10% damage, +20% Mend rate for 120 s); the top damage dealer wears the Lily Crown for the rest of the session

plan.overview: Higanbana Battlegrounds. Roblox battlegrounds (anime-style free-for-all PvP brawler with a server world boss), original IP. PC, mobile, tablet and console, mobile-first touch controls. Ages 9+, mild violence, no blood.
plan.pitch_and_usp: Wake on the far shore of the river of the dead, master one of the Five Phases and out-fight every other soul while your fighting wakes a tree that only the right phase can wound. Why this over Jujutsu Shenanigans or The Strongest Battlegrounds: a world of its own that no anime owns, a Five Phases matchup layer that turns every fight into a counter-pick question, and PvP that grows a raid boss instead of a timer.
plan.core_concept: 0 min: pick a fighter (Iwao, the easiest, is highlighted), land a first chain on a training dummy and see 'Overcome!'. 5 min: brawling in the riverbed, a first ultimate or Mend, a first kill, a first death and a counter-pick from the recap. 30 min: two or three Elder awakenings, swapping phases to wound its changing heart, a streak call-out, chasing the Lily Crown. Tomorrow: nothing persists this build (saving is out of scope), so the pull is mastery of five movesets and twenty matchups; saving and daily goals come next.
plan.player_experience: Weighty, readable and a little eerie: hits with hit-stop and crimson Ki spraying from every strike, lilies swaying in a dusk that never ends. Every hit says whether you are winning the matchup (relation icon and damage-number colour), so a loss reads as a lesson, not luck. First win inside 30 s (a full chain and 'Overcome!' on a dummy), first kill within about 3 minutes, first Elder fight around minute 5 on a busy server.
plan.audience: Primary: the battlegrounds audience, 9-16, mostly on phones, competitive-casual, already playing Jujutsu Shenanigans and The Strongest Battlegrounds and happy to learn movesets. Secondary: anime fans who like dark Japanese folklore. Social play is incidental (same server, Elder raids), not organised.
plan.market: Looked at (design/research.md): Jujutsu Shenanigans (84K concurrent, 8B visits; ~178K live in June 2026) and The Strongest Battlegrounds (42.5K, 19.7B visits) lead a 657K-player sub-genre, followed by a long tail of anime homages (Anime Ability Arena, Legends Battlegrounds, Jujutsu Beatdown, Heroes Battlegrounds). What they do well: instant recognition, simple four-ability kits, weighty hits. What they do badly (my reading): they own none of their worlds, ride another company's release calendar and have no matchup layer. The gap: an original world with a strong look, a readable counter system and a PvP-fed PvE event.
plan.mechanics: Movement: walk, run, jump, dash (1.8 s), knockback and ring-outs off the cliffs. Combat: 4-hit M1 chains, hold-to-block with a 100-point guard, 0.22 s parry, guard break, four abilities and an ultimate per fighter, three passives (Rhythm, Fare, Arrest) plus Iwao's knockback resistance, statuses (stun, slow, root, bound, silence, burn, purified, super armor, sprout). Phases: Overcome / Resisted / Feeding / Drawing on every hit. Ki: fills from dealing and taking damage, spent on the ultimate (100) or Mend (hold R: 12 Ki/s into health, broken by any hit, locked 3 s after damage). World: safe landing, no-PvP training beach, the Thirst meter and the Elder event. Economy: Lily Petals as a session score.
plan.progression: Short term (minutes): land a chain, a first kill, a first ultimate, learn a matchup. Medium term (a session): streaks (called out at 3, 5 and 10), Elder contributions, the Lily Crown, the top of the Petal board. Long term: none this build, deliberately: levels, unlocks and saved stats need a datastore, which is out of scope.
plan.content: One map, the Far Shore, in five areas. Five fighters (one per phase), each with an M1 chain, four abilities and an ultimate: 30 moves, plus 3 passives. Five phase training dummies. One world boss, the Thirsting Elder: a phase-cycling heart, 3 attacks, a breakable grab branch, an enrage with 3 Sap Sprouts. Collectibles: Lily Petals (score) and the Lily Crown (session cosmetic). No other NPCs: the select altar is a lantern at the ferry hut.
plan.world: Ferry Landing (south): spawn, select altar, safe zone; grey pier, ferry lanterns, a vermilion torii; no difficulty; open from the start. The Dry Riverbed (centre): the main arena; stranded ferry boats and cairns for cover, a stone bridge overhead; free-for-all, hardest PvP; open. Lily Fields (south-east, a low hill east of the landing): rolling spider lilies with bamboo edges, long sightlines over the riverbed for zoners, a flank route; medium; open. Jizo Beach (west reach, a Sai no Kawara of cairns and red-capped Jizo): training with the five phase dummies and a stone tablet of the two cycles; no PvP, Ki earned there is rolled back on leaving; open. Elder's Grove (north bank): a clearing of old banners and armour around the dormant Elder, whose heart pulses faster as the Thirst fills; the boss arena when it wakes; hardest; open, but the Elder only wakes on a full Thirst. Edges: cliffs into a sea of mist, a fall is a death credited to the last hitter.
plan.story: Every autumn equinox the red spider lilies bloom on the far shore of the Sanzu, the river every soul must cross. This year the river has run dry. Souls who still have their arts in them wake on its stones, and the ferryman's old tale says the river will carry one of them back to the living when it returns. Until then the shore belongs to whoever is still standing, and to the Thirsting Elder, a tree that grew where the last battle of a forgotten war was fought and drinks every drop of Ki spilled on its roots. Kept to one paragraph, fighter one-liners and the Elder's description; told through the world, not cutscenes. Later acts (not this build): II The Lantern Procession, III The River Returns.
plan.ui_ux: Phase Select: five cards around the Five Phases wheel (generating arrows outside, overcoming star inside), a detail panel with role, difficulty and moves, and a Cross button: 2 clicks. HUD: health, Ki (ultimate-ready glow), guard, five ability slots with cooldown sweeps, phase badge, the relation icon on the targeted enemy, status icons, kill feed, combo counter, damage numbers coloured by relation, the Thirst bloom, the Elder bar (heart phase and next-phase timer), announcement banner, Petals and streak, Mend bar. Death Recap: who beat you, with what relation, and the phase that counters them; 1 click opens Phase Select with the counter highlighted, or you respawn as the same fighter after 4 s. Elder Reward popup. Touch controls: ATTACK, BLOCK, DASH, 1-4, ULT, MEND, PHASE. Leaderboard: the Roblox player list with leaderstats. Using any ability is one key or one tap.
plan.tutorial: 0:00 spawn on the landing quay; Phase Select opens with Iwao highlighted as the easiest. 0:15 after crossing, a lantern trail and a prompt point west to Jizo Beach ('Learn the Five Phases', optional). 0:30 the first dummy hit pops a relation card ('Overcome! Earth overcomes Water: +20%'). Contextual prompts tick off one at a time: M1 chain, block (the striker dummy attacks back), parry timing, dash, abilities 1-4, then Ki fills and 'G: ultimate ready'. 2:00 'The riverbed awaits'; leaving the beach rolls Ki back. In the riverbed the Thirst bloom appears with a one-line tooltip ('every hit spills Ki; when the lily blooms, the Elder wakes'). First awakening: a banner names the heart's phase, what overcomes it and what feeds it.
plan.art_direction: Ukiyo-e afterlife at eternal dusk: ink-black silhouettes, crimson spider lilies, bone-white stone and mist, aged gold for coins and lanterns. Stylised and hand-painted with chunky shapes that read on a phone; no photoreal PBR. Every asset class matches: meshes painted with paint_texture.py in the shared palette, phase accent colours (Wood green, Fire vermilion, Earth ochre, Metal silver-white, Water indigo) only on fighter kit and phase effects; VFX share those accents and use crimson Ki motes as the universal hit language; UI is brush-stroke bars on lacquer-black panels with gold trim; lighting is Future with a low sun, teal-grey fog and bloom on lilies and lanterns. Players keep their own avatar plus a fighter kit (a weapon and one worn piece).
plan.audio: Music per state: Ferry Landing and select (calm shakuhachi and koto), riverbed fighting (a low-intensity taiko loop that ducks under combat), Elder awake (intense taiko and shamisen), Elder enraged (a faster layer), Elder felled (the reward fanfare). Ambience: dusk wind, bell crickets, creaking stranded hulls, a distant temple bell. SFX roles in design/sfx.json: per-weapon swings, hit tiers with an Overcome accent, block, parry, guard break, dash, Ki full, Mend, every ability, passive and ultimate, every Elder attack and heart change, UI, death and respawn.
plan.technical_architecture: A fork of the Tidebell Battlegrounds engine (games/TidebellBattlegrounds/src), made in section 2: one server Script bootstrapping service modules, one client LocalScript bootstrapping controllers, Remotes declared in default.project.json; no Knit, so the Knit template new_game.py laid down is replaced. Shared pure modules, Lune-tested with no Roblox globals: Phases, Fighters, CombatMath, ElderRules, Poses, VfxCatalog. Engine services: Players, RunService, ReplicatedStorage, CollectionService, TweenService, Debris, PhysicsService collision groups, Workspace raycasts and spatial queries, SoundService, Lighting (Atmosphere, Bloom, ColorCorrection, SunRays), Animator and AnimationController for authored clips. Tooling: Rojo, Lune, selene, StyLua, luau-lsp, the roblox-map builder output loaded by MapService. A combat trace behind workspace attribute HiganCombatDebug prints why each intent was refused and each hit check's candidates.

data_saving.declined: Session-only stats this build (scope law: no datastore). Petals, kills, streaks and the Lily Crown reset when the server closes, so nothing can be lost to a failed save. Next update: ProfileStore with session locking via roblox-data-stores.

plan.security: Server-authoritative. Clients send only intents: Action(slot, aimUnit), SetBlock(bool), Dash(direction), Mend(bool), SelectFighter(id). The server checks argument types, NaN and unit length on vectors, rate-limits every remote per player, and decides cooldowns, stun/silence/root state, hit detection, relation multipliers, damage, Ki, Mend conditions, phase switching (out of combat 8 s), the safe and no-PvP zones, kill credit, Elder contribution and every reward. Ki earned on the training beach is rolled back on leaving it.
plan.multiplayer: Up to 12 players per server (the VFX and animation budget on phones). Free-for-all. When a player leaves, their projectiles, grabs, rings and binds end, kill credit for anyone they damaged in the last 10 s passes to the next-highest damager, and their Elder contribution is dropped; the Elder's health is fixed at awakening. Solo play works: the dummies and an Elder scaled to one player.

monetisation.declined: No Robux this build (out_of_scope). When it comes it is cosmetic only (Lily Crown variants, Ki colours, weapon skins), never power.

plan.economy: One currency, Lily Petals, used as a session score. Enters: +5 per kill, +2 per streak step above 2, +30 for an Elder contribution of at least 4% of its health. Leaves: never, because there is no shop in scope, so nothing can inflate; it ranks the server board and resets with the server.
plan.retention: In a session: the Elder wakes every 5 to 7 minutes on a busy server, streak call-outs, the Lily Crown, and twenty phase matchups to learn. Across days: weak by design this build, because nothing persists (no datastore, out of scope); the next update adds saving, daily phase challenges and cosmetic unlocks.
plan.social: Leaderboard (leaderstats: Petals, Kills, Streak), kill feed, server-wide streak and Elder announcements, the visible Lily Crown, and the Elder's grab that another player can break to free you. Declined: friends lists, parties, teams, trading and chat features beyond default Roblox chat.
